item.where: The branched timelines, struck from the TVA
item.cause: General Dox secretly arms her loyal hunters with reset charges to wipe out all the new branched timelines at once.
item.out: Enchanted by Sylvie, Brad Wolfe reveals the plan, and Loki, Mobius and Sylvie capture Dox. Her plan has largely worked, though, and most of the branches are destroyed while some of her loyalists escape.
loss: Most of the new branched timelines, and everyone in them.
fall: Locked up, Dox refuses to join Renslayer, and Miss Minutes crushes her and her loyalists.
Loki S2
The surviving branches keep flooding the Temporal Loom until it explodes, and Loki destroys it and holds the timelines together at the end of time.
Loki S2

item.b: Ant-Man's Avengers stood united. Now they don't stand at all.

item: Spider-Man takes down Tombstone, Ramrod and Boomerang
Mac Gargan, the Scorpion, escapes custody
Much of Manhattan held still by an unexplained force
Six Los Angeles teens wanted in the death of Destiny Gonzalez

item.n: The Battle for the Infinity Hulk
item.where: Paris, France, in the reality overrun by zombies
item.cause: Wanda gathers a horde large enough to overwhelm the Infinity Hulk and take the Infinity Stones' energy he has been holding back.
item.out: Kamala's group and the sorcerers of Kamar-Taj defend the Hulk, but the horde and the zombie Thor overwhelm them, and the Hulk's blast that destroys Thor leaves him open for Wanda to take the power. Wanda persuades Kamala to help her remake the world, and Kamala wakes in what seems to be her old life.
loss: Blade Knight, Sara and the London Master, killed by the zombie Thor.
Valkyrie and Rintrah, killed by the horde, and Shang-Chi, infected.
Thor, destroyed by the Hulk's blast.
Emil Blonsky, destroyed by the Hulk in the first wave.
fall: Riri Williams hacks into the illusion to tell Kamala that what she sees is not real.
Marvel Zombies

item.where: San Francisco, spreading across the world, in the reality overrun by zombies
item.cause: Hank Pym brings Janet van Dyne back from the Quantum Realm, unaware that a quantum virus has turned her, and she infects him. The Avengers go to San Francisco to contain the outbreak and are infected too.
item.out: The virus overruns the world within weeks. A band of survivors reaches Camp Lehigh, where Vision has cured Scott Lang's head with the Mind Stone but has been feeding the living to the zombified Wanda; when she breaks free, Vision gives Peter Parker the Stone, the Hulk holds Wanda off, and Peter, Scott and T'Challa set out for Wakanda.
loss: Happy Hogan, Sharon Carter and Kurt, killed by zombies.
Okoye, infected by the zombie Wanda, and Bucky Barnes, hurled away by her and never found.
Vision, who ends his own life to give Peter the Mind Stone.
Most of humanity, the Avengers among them, turned into zombies.
fall: In Wakanda, a zombie Thanos waits for the Mind Stone, and T'Challa drives him into the vibranium core.
Marvel Zombies
Five years on, Wanda rules the hordes as the Queen of the Dead.
Marvel Zombies
The Nova Corps quarantine Earth and shoot down anyone who tries to leave.
Marvel Zombies

item.where: The Williamsburg Bridge, New York
item.cause: Newly changed by his own lizard serum, Dr. Curt Connors goes after Rajit Ratha on the Williamsburg Bridge as the Lizard, tearing through traffic and hurling cars aside.
item.out: Spider-Man webs up the wreckage, saves a boy trapped in a car hanging over the edge, and fights the Lizard until it escapes into the river.
loss: Cars and the roadway of the Williamsburg Bridge.
fall: Captain Stacy blames the masked vigilante for the chaos and orders Spider-Man's arrest.
The Amazing Spider-Man
The rescued boy's father, a crane operator, later lines up cranes along the avenue to help the wounded Spider-Man reach Oscorp Tower.
The Amazing Spider-Man

item.b: A class of young mutants, with Emma Frost and Banshee teaching. School's out.
Fury's pager went dark. Minutes later, a woman we've never seen walked into the compound. She is asking where Fury is. Rogers, Romanoff, Banner and Rhodes are with her now.

item: Energy barrier cuts off Westview, New Jersey

item.where: The Wonder Man set, Hollywood, Los Angeles
item.cause: Simon Williams learns that his friend Trevor Slattery has been spying on him for Damage Control, which has been watching Simon for signs of hidden powers, and he loses control of them.
item.out: The blast wrecks the set of Von Kovak's Wonder Man film and sets off a manhunt. To protect Simon, Trevor claims the explosion in his old role as the Mandarin and is arrested by Damage Control.
fall: Trevor is locked in a Damage Control prison, and Von Kovak finishes the film without him.
Wonder Man
After the film's success, Simon breaks Trevor out of the prison and flies off with him.
Wonder Man

item.n: The Raid on the Xavier School
item.where: Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters, Westchester County, New York
item.cause: After a mind-controlled Nightcrawler attacks the President in the White House, William Stryker wins approval to move against Xavier's school.
item.out: Stryker's soldiers storm the mansion at night and carry off several students while Colossus leads the rest to safety. Logan fights them off and escapes with Rogue, Bobby and John, and Stryker, who knows him as Wolverine, gets away.
loss: The students seized by Stryker's soldiers and taken to Alkali Lake.
fall: Storm and Nightcrawler free the captive children at Alkali Lake.
X2
The X-Men hand Stryker's files to the President.
X2

item.n: The Destruction of the Xavier School
item.where: Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters, Westchester County, New York
item.cause: Woken in 1983, En Sabah Nur reaches into Cerebro through Charles and forces every nation to launch its nuclear arsenal into space, then comes to the mansion with his Horsemen to take him.
item.out: Alex blasts Cerebro apart to break the hold, and when the Horsemen come for Charles, his blast at them strikes a generator and the explosion destroys the mansion. Peter races through and carries the students out, but Charles is taken, and Colonel Stryker's forces arrive and seize Hank, Raven, Peter and Moira.
loss: Alex Summers, killed in the explosion.
The world's nuclear missiles, launched into space.
fall: Scott, Jean and Kurt free their friends at Alkali Lake, where Weapon X breaks loose.
X-Men: Apocalypse
Erik and Jean help rebuild the school.
X-Men: Apocalypse

item.b: President Ross says the world needs the Avengers again. I think he's right, and I'm putting them back together. I'll need people I can trust. Consider this your call.

item.where: Thanos's farm, the Garden
item.cause: Three weeks after the Snap, Nebula leads the surviving Avengers and Carol Danvers to the Garden, the planet where Thanos has gone to rest, hoping to take the stones and undo what he did.
item.out: They find that Thanos has used the stones to destroy the stones, which nearly killed him, so nothing can be undone. Thor cuts off his head.
loss: The six Infinity Stones, destroyed by Thanos.
fall: Thor gives up and drinks away the next five years in New Asgard.
Avengers: Endgame
Five years later, Scott Lang comes back from the Quantum Realm, and the Avengers use it to go back in time for the stones.
Avengers: Endgame

item: Mutant attacks the President in the Oval Office

item.where: The Staten Island Ferry, New York Harbor, New York
item.cause: Tipped off by Aaron Davis, Peter Parker crashes Adrian Toomes's sale of Chitauri weapons to Mac Gargan aboard the Staten Island Ferry, wrecking an FBI sting that Tony Stark had set up.
item.out: In the fight with the Vulture, one of the crew's alien guns misfires and slices the ferry in half. Peter webs the two halves together until Tony arrives in an Iron Man suit and welds the ship back together.
loss: The ferry, split down the middle and badly damaged.
fall: Tony takes back the suit he gave Peter.
Spider-Man: Homecoming
Mac Gargan, arrested on the ferry, later meets Toomes in prison and presses him to name Spider-Man.
Spider-Man: Homecoming

item: CIA Director Valentina Allegra de Fontaine faces impeachment

item.where: A scrapyard holding a decommissioned Helicarrier, New York
item.cause: Ajax kidnaps Vanessa to draw out Deadpool and holds her on a decommissioned Helicarrier in a scrapyard.
item.out: Deadpool brings Colossus and Negasonic, who fight Angel Dust and Ajax's men while he goes after Ajax. Negasonic's blast takes out the ship's supports and it collapses as Deadpool shields Vanessa; Ajax admits there is no cure, and Deadpool shoots him dead.
loss: Ajax, shot dead by Deadpool, and many of his mercenaries.
The Helicarrier, brought down in the scrapyard.
fall: Vanessa forgives Wade once she sees his face and learns why he stayed away.
Deadpool
Two years on, Deadpool is hunting crime bosses, and one of them kills Vanessa.
Deadpool 2

item: Life Foundation rocket explodes on launch
Jailed actor Trevor Slattery, who played the Mandarin, sits down for a documentary

sides.A: Tony, Peter, Strange, the Guardians and Nebula

beats: Ebony Maw's ship comes down on Titan with Tony Stark, Peter Parker and Doctor Strange aboard.
Peter Quill, Drax and Mantis are already there. The two groups fight, then agree to work together.
Thanos arrives expecting Maw and finds Strange, and with the Reality Stone shows him Titan as it once was.
They spring the ambush, each taking a turn at Thanos.
Nebula crashes down and joins the fight.
Mantis puts Thanos under, and the others nearly pull the gauntlet off his hand.
Quill learns from Nebula that Thanos killed Gamora, strikes him and wakes him.
Thanos pulls Titan's moon apart and brings it down on them.
Thanos stabs Tony. Strange gives up the Time Stone to spare Tony's life, and Thanos leaves for Earth.
After the Snap, Quill, Drax, Mantis, Strange and Peter turn to dust. Tony and Nebula are left.

item.where: The Watchtower, Midtown Manhattan, New York
item.cause: Valentina Allegra de Fontaine turns Bob Reynolds into the Sentry to save her career, and when Bob turns on her, Mel stops him with a kill switch. The shock sets loose the Void, Bob's dark side, which spreads from the old Avengers Tower across Manhattan.
item.out: The darkness turns New Yorkers into shadows trapped in their worst memories. Yelena Belova walks into it to find Bob, the others follow her through his past, and together they reach him and help him overcome the Void, and the light and its victims return.
fall: To save herself, Valentina presents the team to the world as the New Avengers.
Thunderbolts*
Fourteen months later, the New Avengers are in a legal fight with Sam Wilson over the Avengers name.
Thunderbolts*

item.b: Short adventures, happy endings, every time. Except this time.

item.where: Bloodstone Manor
item.cause: During the hunt for the Bloodstone held after Ulysses Bloodstone's death, his widow Verussa catches Jack Russell freeing the hunt's prey, his friend Ted, and uses the Bloodstone to force Jack into his werewolf form so that he will kill Elsa Bloodstone.
item.out: The werewolf breaks out of the cage and tears through the manor's guards, while Elsa kills the hunters Barasso and Azarel. Recognizing Elsa's scent, the werewolf spares her and escapes, and Ted burns Verussa to death as she tries to shoot Elsa.
loss: Verussa Bloodstone, burned to death by Ted.
Barasso and Azarel, killed by Elsa.
The manor's guards, killed by the werewolf.
fall: Elsa takes the Bloodstone and the family manor.
Werewolf by Night
Jack wakes in the forest as a man again, with Ted watching over him.
Werewolf by Night

item.where: Rockefeller Center, Manhattan, New York
item.cause: Wilson Fisk, the Kingpin, sends the Tracksuit Mafia to kill Eleanor Bishop at her Christmas Eve party after she tries to break with him, while Yelena Belova comes for Clint Barton, whom she blames for Natasha's death.
item.out: Clint and Kate Bishop, with Jack Duquesne and a group of LARPers, get the guests out and fight the Tracksuits around the Christmas tree, which Kate brings down to free Clint. Kate beats Fisk in the street, Yelena learns the truth about Natasha and lets Clint go, and the police arrest Eleanor for the murder of Armand Duquesne III.
loss: The Rockefeller Center Christmas tree, toppled.
fall: Maya Lopez confronts Fisk with a gun, and a shot rings out.
Hawkeye
Fisk survives Maya's shot and follows her home to Oklahoma.
Echo
Clint burns the Ronin suit and spends Christmas at the farm with his family and Kate.
Hawkeye

item.b: I'm looking for my brother, Tommy. He came back the same way I did, in someone else's life. If your files ever turn up a kid who runs too fast, tell me.

item: Worthington Labs announces a cure for mutation

item.where: Gulmira, Afghanistan
item.cause: Armed with Stark weapons that Obadiah Stane keeps selling them, the Ten Rings seize Gulmira, Ho Yinsen's home village, and turn its people out of their homes.
item.out: Tony flies in as Iron Man, wipes out the Ten Rings fighters and their tank and leaves their leader, Abu Bakaar, to the villagers. Flying home, he is chased by Air Force jets until Rhodey, learning who is in the suit, calls them off.
loss: Villagers killed by the Ten Rings.
fall: Rhodey tells the press the fight was a training exercise.
Iron Man

item.where: The Burren Club, Hell's Kitchen, New York
item.cause: With Wilson Fisk in prison, the Kitchen Irish gather at their club to plan their return to the city's drug trade, and Frank Castle, waging war on the gangs he blames for his family's death, comes for them.
item.out: Frank shoots their leader, Nesbitt, through the wall in the middle of his speech and kills every man in the room but Grotto, who escapes, bleeding, to Josie's bar and begs Nelson and Murdock for help.
loss: Nesbitt and the Kitchen Irish crew gathered with him.
fall: Frank tracks Grotto to the hospital and shoots Daredevil in the head, and Matt's helmet saves him.
Daredevil S2
Finn Cooley takes over the Kitchen Irish to hunt down the shooter, captures Frank and tortures him, and dies when Frank breaks free.
Daredevil S2
Frank shoots Grotto dead in front of Matt.
Daredevil S2

item.t: A Funny Thing Happened on the Way to Thor's Hammer
item.b: Stopped for gas on the way to New Mexico and walked into an armed robbery. Two suspects, both down. I'm back on the road. No need to put this in the report.

item.where: Otto Octavius's harbor warehouse, New York
item.cause: Fueled with Harry Osborn's tritium, Otto Octavius's rebuilt fusion reactor in a harbor warehouse runs wild, its pull dragging metal from all around and threatening the city.
item.out: Spider-Man comes to free Mary Jane and fights Doc Ock in the warehouse. Unmasked, Peter talks Otto back to himself, and Otto has the arms drown the reactor in the river, sinking with it.
loss: Otto Octavius, who drowns with his reactor.
fall: Mary Jane, now knowing Peter is Spider-Man, leaves her wedding to John Jameson to be with him.
Spider-Man 2
Pulled into another universe as he drowns, Otto fights that world's Spider-Man, who frees him from the arms' control.
Spider-Man: No Way Home

item.where: The Baxter Building and the streets below, New York
item.cause: Victor von Doom powers Reed's machine to turn Ben human again, which speeds his own change into metal, then kidnaps Reed and fires a heat-seeking missile at the Baxter Building to kill Johnny.
item.out: Johnny leads the missile away across the city and fools it with a burning garbage barge, Sue frees Reed, and Ben climbs back into the machine to become the Thing again. The four fight Doom in the streets and freeze him solid, with Johnny and Sue wrapping him in fire and Ben and Reed dousing him with water.
fall: Ben chooses to stay the Thing, Reed proposes to Sue, and the frozen Doom is shipped home to Latveria.
Fantastic Four (2005)
The Silver Surfer's passage over Latveria frees Doom from his frozen state.
Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer

item.b: Asgard is destroyed. This ship carries its survivors under King Thor, and we are setting course for Earth. Asgard is not a place. It's a people.

item: Captain America is alive, and fighting in Midtown
Meet the Avengers: the heroes who saved New York
San Francisco car chase: witnesses say the cars kept shrinking
Giant man seen wading in San Francisco Bay

item.where: The S.H.I.E.L.D. Helicarrier, in flight
item.cause: Loki lets himself be captured, and while the Avengers argue aboard the Helicarrier, Clint Barton leads Loki's agents in an attack that blows out one of its engines.
item.out: Bruce Banner turns into the Hulk and fights Thor inside the ship until he leaps onto a fighter jet and falls away, while Tony Stark and Steve Rogers get the engine running again. Natasha Romanoff knocks Clint free of Loki's control, and Loki drops Thor from the ship in the Hulk's cage, kills Phil Coulson and escapes.
loss: Phil Coulson, run through by Loki with the scepter.
fall: Fury tosses Coulson's bloodied trading cards to Steve, and the Avengers come together to go after Loki.
The Avengers
Coulson is brought back to life by Project T.A.H.I.T.I. and leads a new S.H.I.E.L.D. team.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1

item.n: The Battle for the Kree City
item.where: Beneath San Juan, Puerto Rico
item.cause: Daniel Whitehall's HYDRA drills down to a hidden Kree city beneath San Juan, the city mapped by the symbols Coulson has been carving, meaning to use the Diviner in its temple. Coulson's team moves in to destroy the city before HYDRA can turn it into a weapon.
item.out: Coulson shoots Whitehall dead before Cal can take his revenge, and Raina carries the Diviner into the temple with Skye following to stop her. The Diviner opens and fills the chamber with Terrigen Mist, Trip is caught by one of its shards as he tries to save Skye, and Skye and Raina break out of stone cocoons transformed, setting off an earthquake.
loss: Daniel Whitehall, shot dead by Phil Coulson.
Antoine Triplett, turned to stone by a shard of the Diviner and shattered in the quake.
fall: Grant Ward and Kara Palamas escape together.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
The Diviner's activation draws the Kree warrior Vin-Tak to Earth to kill Skye, until Sif takes him home.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2
Skye learns to control her earthquake powers at Afterlife, the hidden home of the Inhumans, led by her mother Jiaying.
Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2

item.where: The Heirlum Biotechnologies facility, Chicago
item.cause: Parker Robbins, the Hood, leads his crew, with Riri Williams along in her armor, on a raid of Heirlum Biotechnologies to force a contract on its chief executive Hunter Mason and burn his greenhouses.
item.out: Parker kills Mason with the power of his cloak while Riri secretly cuts a piece from it, and the facility's alarms seal the crew inside greenhouses filling with carbon dioxide. John King catches Riri with the piece of the cloak and attacks her, and when N.A.T.A.L.I.E. flies Riri out in the suit, the greenhouse seals behind them with John inside.
loss: Hunter Mason, killed by Parker Robbins.
John King, suffocated in a sealed greenhouse.
fall: Police trace Riri's bio-mesh to Ezekiel Stane, who is arrested and then turns against her.
Ironheart
Parker tells his crew that Riri is to blame for John's death, and they turn on her.
Ironheart
Zeke Stane tears Riri's suit apart.
Ironheart

item.where: Oscorp Tower, New York
item.cause: As the Lizard, Curt Connors takes a gas device to the top of Oscorp Tower to turn everyone in New York into a lizard like him.
item.out: Gwen makes an antidote, and Captain Stacy carries it up the tower to Spider-Man. The Lizard mortally wounds Stacy, but Spider-Man releases the antidote as a cloud over the city, and Connors and his victims return to human form.
loss: Captain George Stacy, killed by the Lizard.
fall: Dying, Captain Stacy asks Peter to stay away from Gwen.
The Amazing Spider-Man
Connors is jailed, and a man in the shadows visits his cell to ask about Peter's father.
The Amazing Spider-Man
Peter keeps seeing Captain Stacy as he struggles with his promise.
The Amazing Spider-Man 2
Pulled into another universe, Connors is cured by the Peter Parkers there and sent home.
Spider-Man: No Way Home

item.where: The village of Ta Lo, a hidden realm
item.t: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
item.cause: Wenwu believes he hears his dead wife Ying Li calling to him from behind Ta Lo's Dark Gate, and he leads the Ten Rings against the village to break the gate down. The voice belongs to the Dweller-in-Darkness, sealed behind the gate with its soul eaters.
item.out: Ta Lo's defenders meet the Ten Rings at the village, until Wenwu's attack on the gate frees the soul eaters and the two armies join forces against them. The Dweller breaks loose, and Wenwu dies saving his son, passing him the Ten Rings; Shang-Chi, with the Great Protector and an arrow from Katy Chen, kills the Dweller.
loss: Wenwu, whose soul the Dweller-in-Darkness takes after he gives Shang-Chi the Ten Rings.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Death Dealer, killed by a soul eater.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Guang Bo, killed by a soul eater.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
fall: Wong brings Shang-Chi and Katy to Kamar-Taj, where the Ten Rings are found sending out a beacon.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
Xialing takes command of the Ten Rings.
Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

item.b: Tony asked me to send this to everyone on his list if it ever came to it. He wanted to say thank you. And he said to get some rest. You've all earned it.
Wolverine's X-Men, the Avengers and a young Thor shared this Earth. Now they share its file.
Iron Man, Wolverine, the X-Men and Blade all went to Japan. Where they went next, nobody followed.

item.n: The Battle of the Cuban Blockade
item.where: The U.S. blockade line and a beach on the coast of Cuba
item.cause: Sebastian Shaw, leading the Hellfire Club, bends the Soviet generals into sending nuclear missiles to Cuba and follows the fleet in his submarine, meaning to start a nuclear war that will leave mutants to rule what remains.
item.out: Charles makes a Soviet sailor destroy the missile ship, and Erik lifts Shaw's submarine onto the beach, tears off his helmet and, while Charles holds him frozen, drives the Nazi coin through his skull. The American and Soviet fleets then fire on the mutants; Erik turns the barrage back on them until a bullet he deflects from Moira hits Charles in the spine, and he lets the missiles fall into the sea.
loss: Sebastian Shaw, killed by Erik with his own coin.
Charles Xavier, paralyzed by a deflected bullet.
The Soviet missile ship, and Hank's jet, brought down on the beach.
fall: Erik leaves with Raven, Angel, Azazel and Riptide as Magneto, and they break Emma Frost out of prison.
X-Men: First Class
Charles opens his school and wipes Moira's memory to keep it secret.
X-Men: First Class
By 1973 the school has closed, and Charles walks only with Hank's serum.
X-Men: Days of Future Past
